title: Vulnerability register with lifecycle timestamps
description: Machine-readable register of every identified vulnerability: source, affected component and release hash, CVSS v4 vector, EPSS score and date, KEV membership, reachability determination, assigned SLA, owner, status transitions with timestamps, remediation commit and retest result.
signing: Proposed: signed export per reporting period
retention: Not established; set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Remediation SLA performance report
description: Periodic report of remediation within SLA by severity, aging of open findings, KEV items and overdue counts, with raw denominators and excluded items listed separately.

title: Vulnerability exception register
description: Each exception with scope, risk rationale, compensating controls, approver distinct from requester, expiry date, and review outcome; expired exceptions flagged automatically.

title: Published vulnerability disclosure policy and security.txt
description: Public disclosure policy (scope, safe harbor, reporting channel, acknowledgment targets) and security.txt files with current contact and expiry on each Echelon domain; automated check that expiry has not lapsed.

title: External report intake log
description: Log of external researcher reports: received time, acknowledgment time, triage decision, linked register entry, disclosure coordination and closure.

title: Customer vulnerability advisory and VEX record
description: Advisories and VEX statements issued to customers, with affected releases, exploitability status, timestamps of issue and customer acknowledgment.

title: Deployed component patch currency report
description: Report comparing deployed runtime, database engine, base image and OS versions against latest security releases and vendor support windows, generated from deployment manifests rather than self-attestation.

title: AI-authored remediation verification record
description: For each fix authored or proposed by an AI agent: agent identity, task authorization, diff hash, independent human or second-tool review, regression and security test results, and gate outcome.
producer: Praxis (work protocol and provenance records exist as tooling; not yet operated for a production Echelon service)
